bachelor planning

Information Technology bachelor’s: exact current track to confirm

Compare existing IT study and certifications with the exact current competencies. Keep outside certification costs, included assessments and payable term count together.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Certification bundles
  • Pre-enrollment transfer
  • Competency-based terms
  • Outside purchase versus included-assessment comparison

What needs to be confirmed

  • Program and certification versions determine awards.
  • Submit transcripts before the official prestart deadline; new transfer ends when the initial term begins.
  • The historical recipe lists more candidate units than its stated ceiling and cannot be summed unchanged.
  • Capstones and required assessments can remain even at the transfer ceiling.
  • The October 2026 catalog establishes a 75% ceiling; actual applicable units depend on the program.
  • Official transcript receipt is due by the prior month’s fifth. Confirm your start-specific deadline; transfer stops when the initial term begins.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Check current program title, admission prerequisites and residence eligibility.
  • Check certification age and version rules before earning new credentials.

A practical sequence

  1. Choose current program/track and its competency list.
  2. Inventory courses and certifications with dates and versions.
  3. Allocate unique outputs and enforce program-specific limits.
  4. Approve external prerequisites and submit transcripts by the deadline.
  5. Start the paid term with the evaluated institutional sequence.
  6. Finish assessments, capstone and official degree audit.

Your next useful actions

  • Request an evaluation for the exact IT program.
  • Compare required competencies and term costs before buying certifications.
  • Build the current map rather than summing the historical option menu.

master planning

Competency-based master’s: business or an eligible specialist degree

A graduate CBE family for an eligible bachelor’s holder seeking business or an aligned specialist credential. Compare exact assessments and payable terms with complete master’s alternatives.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Graduate competency-based terms
  • Experience-informed assessment planning
  • Whole-degree cost comparison

What needs to be confirmed

  • Choose an exact current program before course planning.
  • Undergraduate alternative-credit policies do not establish graduate transfer.
  • Admission, intended recognition and required final projects need review.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Confirm bachelor’s recognition and any experience, subject or licensing prerequisites.
  • This profile is not a graduate equivalency map.

A practical sequence

  1. Define graduate purpose and exact degree.
  2. Confirm admission and recognition by the employer or next school.
  3. Get an official decision on prior graduate study.
  4. Map remaining assessments, prerequisites and final projects.
  5. Compare payable terms using a realistic study schedule.
  6. Finish assessments, final project and conferral.

Your next useful actions

  • Identify the exact master’s that meets your purpose.
  • Ask whether any prior graduate work applies.
  • Compare complete prices and workload before optimizing transfer.

bachelor planning

Teacher preparation: online academics with classroom practice

A family for someone who wants to teach in a live school classroom while studying academics online. The intended state, age group and subject determine whether the exact program fits.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Eligible GE/prerequisite transfer
  • Approved educator preparation
  • Supervised classroom practice
  • Placement-first scheduling

What needs to be confirmed

  • Approval and certification depend on jurisdiction and endorsement.
  • Online academics can require local in-person observations and supervised teaching.
  • The researched table is incomplete and cannot support a one-term licensing promise.
  • Placement, background checks, tests and school calendars can create fixed waits.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Say whether you already hold a bachelor’s or teaching license.
  • Confirm exact state/program eligibility, tests and supported placement.

A practical sequence

  1. Choose jurisdiction, grade band, subject and classroom role.
  2. Find the exact approved initial-licensure or postbaccalaureate program.
  3. Evaluate prior study against that preparation route.
  4. Start background checks, assessments and placement support early.
  5. Complete academics, observations and supervised teaching in sequence.
  6. Apply for certification and complete the institutional audit.

Your next useful actions

  • Check the state’s approved preparation list.
  • Ask WGU about your exact endorsement and local placement.
  • Map your prior degree and credit to the appropriate licensure route.

bachelor planning

Prelicensure nursing: prerequisite and clinical-entry guide

Consider nursing entry only after checking geography, admission and supported clinical placements. The research covers a partial prerequisite menu; the complete nursing/licensing sequence needs the current official map.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Approved prerequisite transfer
  • Science/lab matching
  • Clinical admission gate
  • Placement and licensure planning

What needs to be confirmed

  • The old prerequisite table is not a complete BSN plan.
  • State approval and clinical geography determine this route’s eligibility.
  • Science labs, recency, grades, admission and background requirements need review.
  • Online academics do not remove in-person clinical work.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Confirm initial RN preparation versus an RN-to-BSN route.
  • Verify program availability and intended nursing-board rules.

A practical sequence

  1. Identify nursing jurisdiction and existing license status.
  2. Confirm current approval, geography and clinical support.
  3. Evaluate prerequisites with lab, grade and recency requirements.
  4. Complete admission, health/background and placement requirements.
  5. Finish nursing coursework and supervised clinical practice.
  6. Complete degree audit and the board’s examination/licensing process.

Your next useful actions

  • Check the nursing board and current WGU location eligibility.
  • Request the complete prerequisite-to-clinical-to-graduation sequence.
  • Approve science equivalencies before purchasing outside labs.
